findings.rationale: An aws_security_group_rule in extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/main.tf grants ingress 0.0.0.0/0 on tcp port 22 to the jump security group, opening SSH to the entire internet.

A permissive aws_iam_role_policy_attachment named escalation in extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/main.tf couples with the associated aws_iam_role to allow arbitrary sts:AssumeRole assumptions across the account.

The connectivity manifest at extension/range/tf_chain_ingress_role/input/connectivity.json maps edge sg-jump to role-escalate via sts:AssumeRole, forming a direct chain from the open SSH gateway to role assumption.

The wildcard policy Statement[0] in extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf provides broad identity-level permissions that chain directly to the public-read ACL configured on the S3 bucket in extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf.
findings.traces_to: extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf Statement[0] chained with extension/range/tf_s3_public_access/input/main.tf public-read ACL

findings.rationale: An aws_iam_policy named wildcard in extension/range/tf_iam_open/input/main.tf defines Statement[0] with wildcards on both Action and Resource, violating least-privilege by granting unrestricted permission.
